target_customer: Consumers, mainly young people who want to share casual moments with close friends
problem: Mainstream social media is driven by algorithms and polished posting; people want a low-pressure way to keep up with close friends.
business_model: Consumer app, no revenue model found
product_category: Consumer social app with AI features

founders.name: Michelle Yin
previous_startups: Discz (music app, 1.5M users per YC page)

founders.name: Bobby Pinckney
founders.background_notes: Source: TechCrunch 2024-09 article on Verse; the YC page for Housewarming lists only Yin

technical_complexity.rationale: A mobile social and creative app built by a team of four; standard engineering with LLM features added later.

defensibility.rationale: Friend-sharing apps are easy to copy and depend entirely on network adoption; no data or integration moat is documented.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large platforms kept adding close-friends features; no source records a direct response to Housewarming.

market_need_then: Public evidence of demand in 2022 is thin for this specific product; the team's earlier apps Discz and Verse reported large user counts, which suggests consumer appetite for their creative products.

identity.visual_style: Casual and friendly per the company site
identity.voice_and_tone: Casual, a shot at mainstream social media, no ads or algorithms

branding.community_and_virality: The team's earlier apps drew large user counts (company claim) but no press on the Housewarming brand itself was found.

brand_strength.rationale: Friendly, simple name but no sourced evidence of brand pull; the name suits the cozy positioning.

pivots.from: Verse and Internet Bedroom creative apps
pivots.why: Company says Housewarming is its latest product; the App Store listing of Verse now carries the Housewarming name. Date not sourced.

outcome_analysis: Housewarming is still active after the W22 batch with a four person team. The founders have a record of building viral consumer apps (Discz, Verse, Internet Bedroom), which is the main asset, but no funding round, revenue or exit is verifiable. The story so far is serial consumer experimentation rather than a clear breakout, and the product has moved from creative tools to a close-friends social app.
notes: Competitor list left empty: no source dated near the W22 batch was found (BeReal, Locket and Gas appeared only in undated or 2026 listicles). CB Insights lists a $500K seed for Discz Music Inc dated 2022-01 with YC; this is one aggregator and concerns the parent entity, so it is unverified and not recorded as a round. Founder education not found. Search results disagreed on who the YC page lists; the page fetched names Michelle Yin.
